g.title: Doom: console title: D3D12.X, XAudio2, GameInput, saves
XCL's graphics checks: 50/50 of XCL's console checks in Chrome (WebGPU)

svg.text: D3D12 / D3D12.X methods (vtable slots with a runtime function): 63.2% (223/353)
Runtime imports our titles use (6 titles): 85.0% (463/545)
Imports of each title the runtime answers

rect.title: D3D12.X: queue + fence signal on the GPU
D3D12.X: shaders captured; console shader gets a fallback PSO
D3D12.X: retail-format console shader (XDAT/XBCH/FSSM) captured + fallback PSO
D3D12.X: triangle rendered on the real GPU and read back (console + derived pipeline)
D3D12.X: frame clock + PresentX of the title's back buffer
D3D12.X: console device methods (placed title memory, DMA queue + list, page pools)
D3D12.X: console command list memory methods (writes, timestamp, fill, copy, KickoffX, Wait32/64)
D3D12.X: sparse VRAM buffer heaps (placed aliasing, persistent Map coherence, readback)
D3D12.X: coherent window headroom (CUSTOM+WRITE_BACK & oversized READBACK in sparse VRAM)
D3D12.X: async ring-buffered sparse uploads (80 MiB across 20 submits + reused-tile zeroing)
D3D12.X: descriptor heaps still in window 0 after an 8 GiB+ graphics reservation
D3D12.X: committed textures beyond the coherent room are created; a readback buffer still gets coherent memory
D3D12.X: dynamic depth bias via RSSetDepthBiasX (#94)
D3D12.X: raytracing surface (OPTIONS5, AS SRV descriptor, #146/#148 BVH list slots)
D3D12.X: a texture in title memory (XG layout, #44) follows CPU writes
D3D12.X: a texture in a streaming pool gets its texels once pages are mapped in
kernelx: XMemVirtualAlloc – graphics memory type in UMA, others from Windows
kernelx: graphics memory lives in the GPU-visible 4 GiB-aligned region (UMA)
kernelx: unimplemented import becomes a stub and the title keeps running
files: console paths G:\ and GAME: read from the game folder
files: CRT fopen goes through the VFS too
files: writes go to the overlay, game folder untouched
files: delete hides the file without touching the original
files: directory listing merges overlay and hides deleted files
files: T:\ free space (the host volume behind the mount)
static TLS: template on main thread
static TLS: every new thread gets its own initialised copy
xmem: working-set statistics, physical pages mapped and freed
xmem: physical pages mapped into reserved address space keep their contents
modules: GetModuleHandle(NULL) is the game image
modules: LoadLibrary/GetProcAddress on an HLE module
argv: command line belongs to the game
user32: a top-level window made either way (CreateWindowExW / A) is the hidden 1920x1080 console screen
GameInput: GameInputCreate reaches the system GameInput (timestamps advance)
game DLL: static import + DllMain + TLS + its own kernelx import
XTaskQueue: manual, delayed and thread-pool dispatch
XUser: silent sign-in, device association, and no XSTS token offline

g.title: XTaskQueue composite + XNetworking + advapi32legacy LSA fallback: 1/1 (100.0%)

rect.title: XTaskQueue composite + XNetworking + advapi32legacy LSA fallback
storage: save folder + persistent local storage
XPersistentLocalStorage: a drive root, as on the console
DirectStorage (xcrdapi): a file read into memory, status + D3D12 fence
MFPlat: MFResetDXGIDeviceManagerX resets IMFDXGIDeviceManager with the d3d12_xs device
XAudio2: console flags/device, XMA2 & Opus voices decoded, PCM passes, callbacks

svg.text: Green: done. Grey: not yet (no runtime function, or one that only returns E_NOTIMPL). Hover a tile or a square for its name.
Amber: Microsoft's C++ runtime DLLs, which ship beside a title and are recompiled with it; not counted in the percentages.
